title: One word short
hints: Captions that start with a space are counted correctly. Trace `"hi"` by hand and watch `in_word` on the very first character.

A word is counted when a non-space character arrives while `in_word` is false. Before the first character nobody is inside a word yet, but the flag starts out saying you are, so the first word is never counted unless a space comes first.
Start outside a word: `bool in_word = false;`.
